result.summary: 本文提出了 Transformer，一种完全基于注意力机制、摒弃循环与卷积的序列转导网络架构 [abstract][S1.p4]。作者在 WMT 2014 英德与英法翻译任务上验证该模型，英德任务上 big 模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过此前最佳结果（含集成模型）2 BLEU 以上 [abstract][S6.SS1.p1]；英法任务上取得 41.0 BLEU，优于此前所有单模型 [S6.SS1.p2]。作者还将 Transformer 应用于英语成分句法分析，在仅有 WSJ 训练集时也优于 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿符号位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output

method.text: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。其核心是多头注意力：将查询、键、值用不同的学习到的线性投影映射 h 次后并行执行注意力，再拼接并投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]；作者采用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。注意力采用缩放点积形式，即对查询与键的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 并加权求和值 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]。由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦位置编码以利用序列顺序 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder
The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
For each of these we use $d_{k}=d_{v}=d_{\text{model}}/h=64$.
We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
$\mathrm{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\mathrm{softmax}(\frac{QK^{T}}{\sqrt{d_{k}}})V$

Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens
In this work, we use sine and cosine functions of different frequencies:

experiments.text: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享源-目标 BPE 词表约 37000 词）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 word-piece 词表）[S5.SS1.p1]。模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步（12 小时），big 模型训练 300,000 步（3.5 天）[S5.SS2.p1]。作者还做了模型变体实验，在英德开发集 newstest2013 上评估不同注意力头数、键维度、模型规模、dropout 和位置编码的影响 [S6.SS2.p1]。此外，作者在英语成分句法分析任务上训练了一个 4 层、d_model=1024 的 Transformer，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，并在半监督设置下使用约 17M 句的语料 [S6.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
For English-French, we used the significantly larger WMT 2014 English-French dataset consisting of 36M sentences and split tokens into a 32000 word-piece vocabulary.
We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
We trained the base models for a total of 100,000 steps or 12 hours.
The big models were trained for 300,000 steps (3.5 days).
we varied our base model in different ways, measuring the change in performance on English-to-German translation on the development set, newstest2013
We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
We also trained it in a semi-supervised setting, using the larger high-confidence and BerkleyParser corpora from with approximately 17M sentences.

findings.text: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前报告的最佳模型（含集成模型）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 BLEU 的新最优结果 [S6.SS1.p1]；base 模型也超过了所有此前发表的模型和集成模型 [S6.SS1.p1]。在英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于此前所有单模型，训练成本不到此前最优模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。模型变体实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；减小注意力键维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；用学习到的位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码，结果与 base 模型几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。在英语成分句法分析上，模型在缺乏任务特定调优的情况下表现良好，除 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar 外优于所有此前报告的模型 [S6.SS3.p4]；仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时，Transformer 也优于 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
Even our base model surpasses all previously published models and ensembles, at a fraction of the training cost of any of the competitive models.
our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than $1/4$ the training cost of the previous state-of-the-art model
While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
we replace our sinusoidal positional encoding with learned positional embeddings, and observe nearly identical results to the base model
our model performs surprisingly well, yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar
the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences

limitations.text: 作者指出，自注意力在关联任意两个位置时操作数降为常数，但代价是有效分辨率降低，因为注意力加权位置被平均，作者用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制为只考虑以输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部、受限的注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position
We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.

We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
